verdict.rationale: Interconnect and datacenter scale are a fair question for any GPU, so the axis applies. The evidence positions the RX 9070 XT as a local workstation and desktop part, with no documented NVLink/Infinity Fabric-style interconnect, multi-GPU topology, or rack-scale deployment. The 'deploy at scale' claim refers to migrating workloads to separate Instinct datacenter accelerators, not this card, and the 64 MB Infinity Cache is on-die memory, not an interconnect.

support.subject: As an ML engineer, I can train and serve at datacenter scale on this part — documented high-bandwidth interconnect (NVLink, Infinity Fabric), multi-GPU systems, and rack-scale deployment
